method: Each held-out family uses the same question with two book excerpts that support different answers and a third excerpt that is insufficient. These scenes were selected from source ranges absent from all earlier annotated fixtures. The final fixture was committed before training and kept out of checkpoint selection. The Oz book was available during base pretraining.

training.mixed_recipe: Concatenate the bytes of the ordinary training file and eight successive copies of the evidence training file.
training.checkpoint_selection: balanced-first across the evidence and coverage development files, followed by total development matches and ordinary validation loss

evaluation.review_method: Manually check held-out replies against the excerpt and question, accepting equivalent wording. Score abstention only when the reply clearly states that the excerpt lacks sufficient evidence. Regressions and development diagnostics use exact reference matches.
